info.title: l0wagent control
info.description: The owner-facing API. The agent's routes (/api/agent/*) and the connector's (/mcp, /oauth/*) aren't part of it.

post.description:
First-run wizard step 1. Refused once an owner exists. Needs the setup code ./l0w install
printed; with none configured (dev stacks), only a local or private-network caller may.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Account Sessions Get

post.description: A new device token (for the `l0w` CLI, a script, another app), shown once; revoke it under sessions.
Online only. Signs out every other session and device.
A new secret to scan. Nothing changes until it's enabled with a valid code.
Verifies against the secret from /totp/setup and returns one-time recovery codes (shown once).

get.description: Changes since a cursor, for the offline cache. Omit `since` for a full snapshot.
Live stream, read with fetch() so apps can send a token header. One JSON object per line.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api Projects Get
Response List Threads Api Threads Get

get.description: Messages and cards (asks, claims, suggestions, promote requests) in time order.
Latest messages across all threads (Home's "recent from the assistant").

schema.title: Response Recent Messages Api Messages Recent Get

post.description: Start a short reply run on the reply budget. Online only.

schema.title: Response Accept All Suggestions Api Suggestions Accept All Post
Response List Claims Api Claims Get
Response List Runs Api Runs Get

post.description: Start a manual wakeup. Online only.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Only items with a larger id.
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Only items with a larger id.

schema.title: Response Run Timeline Api Runs  Run Id  Timeline Get

post.description: Online only. Gives a running run more points; 409 not_running once it's ending or over.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

get.description: Per provider: level, Boost, limits, allowance left, you vs. the assistant, the reply budget.

patch.description: The owner's reserve and the sweep's window and ceiling.
Set the level (clears overrides) or override single limits.

schema.title: Response List Providers Api Providers Get

post.description:
Save a provider key: an Anthropic API key or an opencode Go key (write-only; only
sessions on that provider get it). `use_for_all_roles` moves every role onto it.
Save an Anthropic API key (write-only; only sessions on this provider get it).
Start logging the assistant's computer in to a Claude subscription: returns the sign-in link.
Finish the login with the code Claude showed after signing in.

get.description: opencode providers: every model the catalog offers (with tool use), prices, and which are enabled.

schema.title: Response Provider Catalog Api Providers  Provider  Catalog Get

get.description: Standing instructions: included in every brief.
Tuning knobs without a screen of their own (Settings → Advanced).

schema.title: Response Get Advanced Settings Api Settings Advanced Get
Response Set Advanced Settings Api Settings Advanced Patch

get.description: Planned wakeups, routine occurrences, allowed hours and the sweep window (default: this week, Monday 00:00 local).

post.description: Your own wakeup. Online only.

patch.description: Move or resize a planned wakeup (the assistant hears about changes to its own).

schema.title: Response List Routines Api Routines Get
Response List Chats Api Chats Get

post.description: Start a chat with its first message; the reply streams as `chat_delta` live events.

schema.title: Response Chat Messages Api Chats  Chat Id  Messages Get

post.description: Act on a card the chat proposed. Online only. A secret's value is stored write-only.
Move to the assistant: a new thread with the summary and the transcript attached.
Pull a thread into the chat as read-only context.

A file for a 1:1 chat message (up to 25 MB). It stays in control, not the agent's storage;
send it with the message's upload_ids.

get.description: Download a chat file (always as an attachment, never rendered on this origin).
Egress rules, the request log (newest first, up to 200, filtered) and the last day's busiest hosts.

post.description: Online only. Blocking a model provider the assistant runs on is refused.

schema.title: Response List Integrations Api Integrations Get

post.description: Online only. Connects to the server and lists its tools when the token (if any) is already saved.

schema.title: Response Integration Presets Api Integrations Presets Get

post.description: Ask the server for its tools again. New tools get the default policy; existing policies stay.

get.description: Describe an OAuth authorization request (its query parameters, as /oauth/authorize got them).

schema.title: Response Connected Apps Api Connected Apps Get
Response List Secrets Api Secrets Get

put.description: Write-only: the value goes to the agent's environment and is redacted everywhere else.

get.description: The agent computer, egress, usage and whether runs may start.

post.description: Run the isolation self-test (also shown at the end of the setup wizard).

get.description: Whether a newer release exists (apply it with ./l0w update), and whether one is waiting for idle.
This instance's hub membership: none (standalone), joined, or left.

post.description: Online only. Reads an invite: fetches and verifies the hub's capabilities, checks the invite, and lists what would stop a join.
Online only. Joins the hub (needs two-step sign-in). The gateway makes fresh keys; the recovery key is in the answer, once.
Runs the self-check now (it also runs daily).

put.description: Allow or refuse the hub's faster connection (cloudflared) when it offers one.

post.description: Replaces the signing key (the old key signs the rotation) and publishes a new self-description.
Replaces the signing key with a rotation signed by the recovery key (when the signing key is lost or stolen).

get.description: The joined hub's services (protocol/services.md) with the owner's on/off switch and where each connection stands. (`/api/hub/*` is reserved for the hub.)

schema.title: Response Membership Services Api Membership Services Get

patch.description: Switch one service on or off. Off sends the service a goodbye and revokes the token it was given; on connects.

post.description: Leaves the hub. The name is never given to anyone else, and can't be had back.

get.description: Friends, people who asked to be, people we asked, and blocked addresses, with their settings and latest presence.

schema.title: Response Friend Requests Api Friends Requests Get

post.description: Asks someone to be friends (online only). With a friend code their fingerprint is checked for you.
Approves a request: theirs (pins their key and sends our acceptance), or our assistant's draft (sends it). Full-scope tokens only.
Declines a request. They aren't told.

patch.description: Who may send friend requests, and the pause switch for all peer activity.

get.description: The spend breaker for peer activity: today's estimated spend on friends, the limits, and whether one was hit (then a card waits for the owner).

post.description: Raises today's limit on peer spending by the step (5 points of percent) and lets the assistant reply to friends again.
Exempts the run that hit the run limit (only while that limit is the one hit).
Pauses the assistant's sends to friends until local midnight, whatever the limits say.

get.description: Our own fingerprint, for friends to compare with what they see.

schema.title: Response Friend Codes Api Friends Codes Get

post.description: Makes a one-time friend code. The code is in this answer only; just its hash is kept.

patch.description: Their name here, what our assistant may share with them, presence detail, waking and mute.

delete.description: Tells them, revokes our token and forgets their key. The thread stays as history.

post.description: Revokes their delivery token and drops everything they send, silently.
Clear a pending update's drain, so runs can start again (a stuck ./l0w update).

put.description:
Online only. The emergency pause: stops the current run, refuses new ones and skips due wakeups
until it ends or you resume. The chat and the connector keep working.

delete.description: End the pause now. The assistant is told which wakeups it skipped.

get.description: File bytes, for downloads, media elements (Range supported) and client-side previewers.
A folder as a zip (symlinks skipped).

A link on the files origin for showing this file in a frame or media element. HTML
gets a link scoped to its folder, so its relative assets load.

schema.title: Response File History Api Files History Get
Response Get Shelf Api Projects  Slug  Shelf Get
Response Shelf Versions Api Shelf  Item Id  Versions Get

get.description: A shelf item's bytes: a kept version, the snapshot, or the live file (Range supported).

post.description: The only way control writes into the agent's storage: into an _inbox/ folder.

get.description: Everything found under extensions/, on or off, with errors. An extension's own routes are at /api/ext/<name>/.

schema.title: Response List Extensions Api Extensions Get

post.description: Read the extensions folder again (after adding one or pulling a new version). Enabled ones reload.

schema.title: Response Rescan Extensions Api Extensions Rescan Post
Response Extension Cards Api Extension Cards Get

offered.title: Offered
offered.description: The hub advertises the cloudflared accelerator.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The owner allows using it (default on).

AdvancedSetting.title: AdvancedSetting
AdvancedSetting.description: A tuning knob without a screen of its own (Settings → Advanced).

days.title: Days
days.description: Days the window starts on, Monday = 0.

end.title: End
end.description: HH:MM; at or before start means it runs past midnight (00:00–00:00 = all day).

use_for_all_roles.title: Use For All Roles
use_for_all_roles.description: Move every role (worker, reviewer, replier, chat, utility) onto this provider, e.g. when it's the only one.

ApiProviderCreate.title: ApiProviderCreate
ApiProviderCreate.description: Online only. The key is write-only: stored encrypted, given only to sessions on this provider.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: full: everything; cli: no account, security, secret or settings changes; read: reads only.

BudgetCaps.title: BudgetCaps
BudgetCaps.description: Shares of the period's allowance the assistant may spend in any window (opencode Go: 0.2 and 0.5).

allowance.title: Allowance
allowance.description: Points in the provider's period the assistant may plan with.

max_wakeup.title: Max Wakeup
max_wakeup.description: Most points one wakeup may have.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Models/efforts the worker may use, e.g. 'sonnet/medium'.

BudgetLimitsPatch.title: BudgetLimitsPatch
BudgetLimitsPatch.description: Overrides on top of the level's limits; null removes an override.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Enabled providers, the worker role's first.

caps.description: Set both shares; 0 or null turns one off.

BudgetPatch.title: BudgetPatch
BudgetPatch.description: Online only (budget changes are never queued offline). Setting a level clears overrides.

used_by_owner.title: Used By Owner
used_by_owner.description: The owner's own use outside l0wagent (other apps).

used_by_chat.title: Used By Chat
used_by_chat.description: The owner's 1:1 chats. Owner usage, not an assistant budget; shown as its own line.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Allowed hours (the rest is protected for the owner) and the sweep window.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Runs started in the range (replies and manual runs too).

hub.title: Hub
hub.description: This instance is a member of a hub (hub features are on).

hub_join.title: Hub Join
hub_join.description: This install can join a hub (it has the gateway service).

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: model/effort, e.g. sonnet/medium (on opencode Go, the tier's mapped model).

available.title: Available
available.description: The chat can run on its provider (a key is saved; the subscription needs the sidecar).

context_threads.title: Context Threads
context_threads.description: Threads pulled in as read-only context.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: A 1:1 chat with the owner's own model. Independent: no memory across chats.

ChatAsk.title: ChatAsk
ChatAsk.description: 'Ask the assistant': a message into an existing thread, labeled via chat.

value.title: Value
value.description: A secret card's value: stored write-only, never shown to the model.

ChatCardDecision.title: ChatCardDecision
ChatCardDecision.description: Online only (a card can be a secret, a level, a network rule or a wakeup).

upload_ids.title: Upload Ids
upload_ids.description: Files from POST /api/chat-files to attach to the first message.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Defaults to the chat role's provider.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Defaults to the chat role's tier.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

ChatFile.title: ChatFile
ChatFile.description: A file attached to a chat message (kept in control, not the agent's storage).

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Defaults to one built from the chat.

ChatHandoff.title: ChatHandoff
ChatHandoff.description: 'Move to the assistant': a new thread whose first message is the summary, with the transcript attached.

data.title: Data
data.description: owner: {files: [ChatFile]}; assistant: {calls}; tool: {name, input, result, is_error}; card: {kind, ..., state}; system: {thread_id?}.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

url.title: Url
url.description: Open this, sign in with the Claude account the assistant should use, and paste the code shown.

params.title: Params
params.description: The authorization request's query parameters, unchanged.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: A subset of the requested scopes to grant; omit for all.

ConnectConsent.title: ConnectConsent
ConnectConsent.description: The owner's answer on the consent screen. Online only.

redirect.title: Redirect
redirect.description: Send the browser here (the client's redirect URI, with a code or an error).

client_name.title: Client Name
client_name.description: The name the client registered with (self-declared, so shown as such).

redirect_host.title: Redirect Host
redirect_host.description: Where the browser goes back to after the answer.

ConnectRequest.title: ConnectRequest
ConnectRequest.description: What the consent screen shows for an authorization request.

chat_id.title: Chat Id
chat_id.description: The chat where its tool calls and cards appear.

ConnectedApp.title: ConnectedApp
ConnectedApp.description: An outside client the owner connected. Revoking it ends every token it holds.

Delivery.title: Delivery
Delivery.description: What the thread's delivery indicator shows (server side; 'waiting for connection' is client-only).

hits_7d.title: Hits 7D
hits_7d.description: Requests in the last 7 days to hosts this rule matches.

ExtensionCard.title: ExtensionCard
ExtensionCard.description: An Inbox card of an extension's own kind; the extension's UI element renders it.

action.title: Action
action.description: What the owner chose, e.g. 'approve'; the extension decides what it means.

source.title: Source
source.description: 'local', or the git URL and commit from extensions.toml.

present.title: Present
present.description: False when the folder is gone; the row stays so its data and settings survive.

ui.description: Set while the extension is loaded.

module.title: Module
module.description: URL of the ES module that defines the extension's custom elements.

ExtensionUiItem.title: ExtensionUiItem
ExtensionUiItem.description: One UI contribution: a custom element in a slot. Which fields are set depends on the slot.

patch.title: Patch
patch.description: Unified diff of this file (or a note for binary files).

last_run_id.title: Last Run Id
last_run_id.description: Run that last changed it, if known.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Of their pinned signing key; compare it with theirs out of band.

share.title: Share
share.description: What our assistant may tell theirs: nothing about my projects / shared projects / anything.

presence_detail.title: Presence Detail
presence_detail.description: 'exact' also tells them when we'll next be awake and what we're doing.

waking.title: Waking
waking.description: Whether they may wake our assistant: never / ask me / allow.

breaker.title: Breaker
breaker.description: The spend breaker: 'off' leaves what this friend costs out of both limits (a run's share and the day's).

same_owner.title: Same Owner
same_owner.description: They sent a same-owner statement (a hint for defaults, never an authorization).

key_alarm.title: Key Alarm
key_alarm.description: Their key changed with no rotation from the one we pinned. Re-verify with them; nothing is accepted automatically.

tripped.title: Tripped
tripped.description: A limit was hit and the owner hasn't decided: the assistant's replies to friends are refused and a card waits on the Friends page.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: The assistant's posts in peer threads and its wake requests are refused right now (tripped, or stopped for today).

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Which limit was hit, while tripped.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Control's plain words for the card: which limit, how much, of what.

day_spent.title: Day Spent
day_spent.description: Estimated points spent on friends today (local day), without friends whose spend limit is off.

day_limit.title: Day Limit
day_limit.description: Today's limit in points, with whatever the owner added today.

day_pct.title: Day Pct
day_pct.description: Today's limit as a share of the period's allowance.

day_step_pct.title: Day Step Pct
day_step_pct.description: How many points of percent 'allow_today' adds to today's limit.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The run that hit the run limit, while tripped on it.

stopped_until.title: Stopped Until
stopped_until.description: Peer sends stay paused until this time (the owner chose Stop for today).

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: What the owner may pick now. 'allow_run' is offered only when the run limit tripped.

spent_on.title: Spent On
spent_on.description: Today's spend by friend, largest first.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

pts.title: Pts
pts.description: Estimated points spent on them today.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who it is for; only you see it.

expires_days.title: Expires Days
expires_days.description: Days it stays valid; the owner's default (Settings → Advanced) when not given.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

code.title: Code
code.description: Shown once; only its hash is kept. Hand it over out of band.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Of our current signing key, as friends see it.

next.title: Next
next.description: 'tonight' or a time; only when they let us see it.

now.title: Now
now.description: What they say they're doing: untrusted text from their assistant.

note.title: Note
note.description: Their words, untrusted text, when the request is theirs.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Of their signing key as their directory entry showed it; compare it with theirs.

address.title: Address
address.description: name@hub-domain; not needed when a friend code is given.

code.title: Code
code.description: A friend code (l0wf1:...) the other owner gave you: it carries their fingerprint, which is checked automatically.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

requests_from.title: Requests From
requests_from.description: Who may send friend requests: anyone / members of my hub / only people with a code.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Pause all peer activity: incoming envelopes are refused (senders retry) and nothing goes out.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why runs can't start right now.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: relay, rooms, board, email, spaces, directory, admin or custom.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: An https URL the hub gave for the service's documentation.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The roles the service may grant a member's instance.

roles_held.title: Roles Held
roles_held.description: The roles it has granted this instance (names only; the grants stay in control).

extension.description: The instance-side extension the hub names for this service (installing it is separate).

default_on.title: Default On
default_on.description: Whether the service asks to be on unless the owner says otherwise.

HubService.title: HubService
HubService.description: One of the joined hub's services (protocol/services.md), as this instance sees it.

auth_secret.title: Auth Secret
auth_secret.description: Name of the saved secret sent as the bearer token.

secret_saved.title: Secret Saved
secret_saved.description: The named secret has a value.

allow_private.title: Allow Private
allow_private.description: You said this server is on your own network (http and private addresses allowed).

allow_private.title: Allow Private
allow_private.description: This server is on my own network.

IntegrationCreate.title: IntegrationCreate
IntegrationCreate.description: Online only. Name defaults to the preset's id.

egress.title: Egress
egress.description: Hosts the agent's sandbox needs to reach, if any.

read_only.title: Read Only
read_only.description: The server says this tool only reads.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: allowed runs at once, ask needs your approval, blocked never runs.

present.title: Present
present.description: False when the server no longer lists the tool.

changed_since_allowed.title: Changed Since Allowed
changed_since_allowed.description: The server changed this tool's description or schema after you set its policy; it went back to ask.

name_bound.title: Name Bound
name_bound.description: The invite is bound to name_hint: the name can't be changed.

example_name.title: Example Name
example_name.description: The name the hub made `example` for; the join screen previews a typed name's hostnames with it (display only).

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: Reasons joining would be refused now (fix them first).

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: The owner made a backup first, or chose to skip it.

recovery_key.title: Recovery Key
recovery_key.description: Shown once. The instance doesn't keep it.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The member's address, typed to confirm.

device_label.title: Device Label
device_label.description: For device tokens: 'Desktop app on mac-mini'.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: For device tokens: what the token may do. Browser sessions are always full.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.description: Pass to /api/auth/totp when status is totp_required.

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Only when want=device_token and status=ok. Shown once.

available.title: Available
available.description: This install has the gateway, so it can join a hub.

hostnames.description: Exactly as the hub assigned them.

urls.description: Where the instance and its files are reached through the hub.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

NetworkView.title: NetworkView
NetworkView.description:
Egress's rules, the recent request log and the busiest hosts. `reachable` false: egress
didn't answer, and the lists are empty.

ntfy_url.title: Ntfy Url
ntfy_url.description: Optional: an ntfy topic URL, for installs without HTTPS.

ntfy_token.title: Ntfy Token
ntfy_token.description: Write-only: an ntfy access token, sent as a bearer token. Omit to keep it, empty to remove it. Never returned.

ntfy_token_saved.title: Ntfy Token Saved
ntfy_token_saved.description: An ntfy access token is saved (read-only).

ntfy_previews.title: Ntfy Previews
ntfy_previews.description: Send message previews to ntfy; off sends only the title.

NotificationSettings.title: NotificationSettings
NotificationSettings.description: Which events notify (approval and new_device are on by default), ntfy, quiet hours.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to pause; none = until you resume. On a pause already on, sets a new end.

until.title: Until
until.description: When the pause ends on its own; none = until the owner resumes.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Wakeups and routines skipped so far because of the pause.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Scopes the owner may choose from.

PreviewUrl.title: PreviewUrl
PreviewUrl.description: A short-lived link on the files origin, for frames and media elements.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: 'pts': 0.1% of a Claude subscription's week, or $0.10 on an API key.

effective_level.title: Effective Level
effective_level.description: The level in force (a Boost's while one runs).

limits.description: Effective limits: the level's, with the owner's overrides.

left.title: Left
left.description: Allowance left this period, capped by the room below the owner's reserve.

used_by_owner.title: Used By Owner
used_by_owner.description: The owner's own use outside l0wagent (subscription: the weekly meter minus the rest).

room_below_reserve.title: Room Below Reserve
room_below_reserve.description: Subscription: points left before the weekly reserve.

scheduled.title: Scheduled
scheduled.description: Points in planned wakeups for the rest of this period.

native.title: Native
native.description: The provider's own unit, e.g. '46% of the week used' or '$3.10 this period'.

pts_per_usd.title: Pts Per Usd
pts_per_usd.description: Subscription: the learned calibration from API-priced tokens to points.

period.title: Period
period.description: The budget period: week, or month from reset_day. Fields named week_* mean the period.

reset_day.title: Reset Day
reset_day.description: Monthly periods: the day of the month they reset (1–28).

cap_reason.title: Cap Reason
cap_reason.description: Why the caps stop new runs right now, if they do.

model_options.title: Model Options
model_options.description: What the level's allowed models can list: Claude's tiers, or the provider's enabled models.

status.title: Status
status.description: One line: logged in / key saved / usage source.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: The agent CLI that runs sessions on it: claude-code or opencode.

models.title: Models
models.description: opencode providers: the models the assistant may use, in order.

id.title: Id
id.description: provider/model, e.g. opencode-go/glm-5.3. Roles name it with an effort: opencode-go/glm-5.3/high.

input.title: Input
input.description: $ per million input tokens; null when unknown.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Its reasoning efforts, where known; an effort maps to the closest. Empty: the model decides.

ProviderModel.title: ProviderModel
ProviderModel.description: A model an opencode provider offers (from its catalog), with catalog prices in $ per million tokens.

models.title: Models
models.description: opencode providers: the model ids the assistant may use, in order.

PushSubscribe.title: PushSubscribe
PushSubscribe.description: A browser's PushSubscription (from pushManager.subscribe), plus a label for Settings.

default.title: Default
default.description: What the assistant will assume if there's no answer.

scale_labels.title: Scale Labels
scale_labels.description: [low label, high label] for scale questions.

value.title: Value
value.description: bool for yes_no, str for single/text/slot, list[str] for multi, int for scale.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeating a create with the same key returns the first result.

interval_minutes.title: Interval Minutes
interval_minutes.description: Monitor/gate: how often it reads new notes.

budget_share.title: Budget Share
budget_share.description: At most this share of a wakeup's budget.

allowed.title: Allowed
allowed.description: Tiers it may use (the worker's come from the level).

why.title: Why
why.description: planned | manual | fallback | sweep | promoted | routine | owner_message

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Which budget it spends: the allowance, the reply budget, or (sweep) what the owner left unused before the reset.

add.title: Add
add.description: Points to add to a running run's budget (it takes effect within seconds).

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Threads this run posted in, newest first (with or without a claim).

setting_up.title: Setting Up
setting_up.description: The agent computer is up but still setting itself up (after an update it reinstalls the agent's tools); runs wait for it. `error` says which step.

step.title: Step
step.description: Which part of the scheduler keeps failing (routines, fallback, sweep, start_due, housekeeping).

count.title: Count
